_about: General terms used on many pages. Owner: supervisor (written by the Phase 1a foundation agent). Other writers: reuse these ids; do not redefine them. Each batch adds its own terms in src/glossary/<batch>.json. Search all glossary files before you add a term.

commit.short: One saved version of a git repository. A 40-character id names it. This site explains one pinned commit.

citation.short: A link to a file and line in the code. Every claim about the code on this site has one.

ttft.short: Time to first token. The time from the arrival of a request to the first output token. Prefill and queue time set it.

tpot.short: Time per output token. The mean time between output tokens of one request, after the first token.

itl.short: Inter-token latency. The time between two output tokens that follow each other in one response stream.

goodput.short: The number of requests per second that also meet the latency targets (for example TTFT and TPOT limits).

front-end.short: The API server process of vllm serve. It runs the HTTP server and AsyncLLM, and sends requests to the engine core process.

openai-compatible-server.short: The HTTP server of vllm serve. Its routes, such as /v1/chat/completions, accept the same requests as the OpenAI API.

async-llm.short: The engine object in the front end of vllm serve. It turns requests into engine inputs, sends them to the engine core and streams the outputs back.

engine-core-client.short: The object in the front end that talks to the engine core: in the same process, or over ZMQ to one or more engine core processes.

engine-core.short: The inner loop of vLLM. It owns the scheduler and the KV cache manager, and it runs steps on the workers. vllm serve runs it in its own process.

executor.short: The object in the engine core that starts the workers and sends work to them: in one process, in many processes, or with Ray.

worker.short: The process or object that owns one GPU. It sets up the device and the process groups, and it holds the model runner.

model-runner.short: The object in a worker that prepares the inputs of a step, runs the model and samples tokens. vLLM uses Model Runner V2 by default.

vllm-config.short: The one object that holds the whole engine configuration: model, cache, parallel, scheduler, compilation and other sub-configs.

zmq.short: ZeroMQ, a message library. vLLM uses ZMQ sockets to send requests and outputs between the front end and the engine core processes.

msgpack.short: MessagePack, a compact binary format for data. vLLM encodes the messages between the front end and the engine core with it.

spawn.short: A way to start a Python child process. The child starts a new interpreter and imports its modules again. It does not copy the memory of the parent.

entry-point.short: A name that a Python package publishes in its metadata, under a group. Other code finds it with importlib.metadata and loads the object it points to.

plugin.short: Code in another Python package that vLLM finds through an entry point and loads, so that it can add or change a feature.

plugin-group.short: An entry-point group name that vLLM reads, for example vllm.general_plugins. Each group has its own purpose and its own load time.

extension-point.short: A place where outside code can change vLLM: a plugin group, a register function, or a config field that names a class.

out-of-tree.short: Code that is not in the vLLM repository, for example a model or a platform in your own package. Short form: OOT.

platform.short: The object that holds the hardware choices of a process (CUDA, ROCm, CPU, ...). Code reads it as current_platform.

custom-op.short: A vLLM layer class with one forward method per platform (forward_cuda, forward_native, ...). It selects one of them when it is made.

token-budget.short: The maximum number of tokens that the scheduler puts into one step, set by max_num_batched_tokens. Prefill and decode tokens share it.

chunked-prefill.short: The scheduler splits a long prompt into parts and runs one part per step, so that it fits the token budget and decode can continue.

preemption.short: The scheduler stops a running request when no free KV cache blocks are left. It frees the blocks and runs the request again later.

block-pool.short: The set of all KV cache blocks on a GPU, with a free list and the hashes of full blocks. The KV cache manager takes blocks from it.

kv-cache-group.short: A set of layers that use the same KV cache layout and share one block table, for example all full-attention layers.

prefix-caching.short: vLLM keeps full KV cache blocks with a hash of their tokens. A new request with the same prefix uses these blocks and skips their prefill.

forward-context.short: An object that vLLM sets before each forward pass. Attention layers read their metadata for the step from it, by layer name.

attention-backend.short: A set of classes that implement attention on a platform, for example FlashAttention or FlashInfer. vLLM selects one per layer type.

cuda-graph.short: A recorded sequence of GPU kernel launches that the GPU can replay with one launch. It removes CPU launch overhead in small steps.

torch-compile.short: The PyTorch compiler. It captures a model as a graph and makes faster code for it. vLLM adds its own backend and passes.

tensor-parallel.short: Each GPU holds a slice of every weight matrix. The GPUs compute their slices of each layer and then combine the results (TP).

pipeline-parallel.short: Each GPU holds a different range of layers. The hidden states go from one GPU to the next (PP).

data-parallel.short: Several copies of the model serve different requests at the same time. In vLLM, each data parallel rank has its own engine core (DP).

expert-parallel.short: The experts of a MoE layer are split across GPUs. Tokens go to the GPUs of their experts and the results come back (EP).

chat-template.short: A Jinja template, usually in the tokenizer files of a model, that turns a list of chat messages into one prompt string.

sse.short: Server-sent events. The server keeps the HTTP response open and sends each part as a 'data:' line. A stream ends with 'data: [DONE]'.

lora-adapter.short: A small set of extra low-rank weights that changes a base model for one task. One server can apply different adapters to different requests.

quantization-method.short: A vLLM class pair that reads a quantized checkpoint and runs its layers, for example FP8, AWQ or GPTQ. --quantization selects it.

request.short: One generation job from a client: a prompt, sampling settings and the output tokens so far. vLLM gives each request an id and tracks it until it finishes.

engine-step.short: One turn of the EngineCore loop: schedule a batch, run the model once, sample, and update the requests. Most requests get one new token per step.

prefill.short: The work on the prompt tokens of a request. It fills the KV cache and gives the first output token. In vLLM, prefill is not a separate phase of the scheduler.

decode.short: The work that makes the output tokens after the first one, usually one token per request per step. It reads the whole KV cache of the request.

batch.short: The set of tokens from many requests that the model runs in one engine step. The token budget limits its size.

scheduler.short: The part of the EngineCore that decides, in each step, which requests run and how many of their tokens. It also allocates KV cache blocks and preempts requests.
